text:
mike_support: Heads up — Fjordly onboarding is blocked at ingest. Support seeing 429s for their account, customer says their pilot is unusable and mentioned pausing the subscription renewal. Escalating to CS for immediate comms and commercial triage. :warning:
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-81234 | severity=high | triggered_by=ingest-quota
mike_support: Quick details: multiple customers on account hit quota within first hour, spikes on sample corpus. Error from host:
```
2024-06-12T15:02:41Z ERROR ingest: quotaExceeded: account_id=fjordly req_count=420 window=1m
2024-06-12T15:02:43Z WARN  ingest: backpressure applied, queue_size=34
```
julia_se: Thanks — do we know if they're on shared or dedicated capacity? If shared, we can propose temporary quota bump; if dedicated, might be config mismatch. Need account plan.
sarah_csm: I can own the comms. @mike_support can you paste the customer plan (tier + committed qps) and any recent config changes? I'll draft a 1-pager to send and propose a fix window.
mike_support: They're on Growth-tier shared plan, onboarding traffic much higher than expected. No config changes. Ticket INC-81234 has the raw logs and request IDs. Adding sample payloads.
leo_csm: I'll join any customer call. Proposed comms plan (30m): 1) Acknowledge issue + apology; 2) Explain temporary mitigation (throttle back noncritical ingest jobs); 3) ETA for quota bump or workaround; 4) Follow-up with postmortem + compensation options. Who can confirm ETA for bump?
julia_se: I can do the bump if we approve burst capacity — estimated 90–120 mins to provision and monitor. Temporary workaround: apply request-level rate-limiter to non-essential endpoints and cache prefixes to reduce load.
sarah_csm: Draft message to customer (short): "Hi Hannah — we're seeing quota errors on your ingest. We're immediately applying a temporary rate limit on non-critical jobs and provisioning burst capacity. Expect service restoration within ~2 hours. We'll join a call at 15:30 to walk through and next steps." Thoughts?
leo_csm: Looks good. Add that we'll follow with a root-cause timeline and any credits as appropriate.
mike_support: I've added @ops-team to INC-81234 and linked a console dashboard. Also flagged renewal team (renewals@redwood) since Fjordly mentioned pause.
sarah_csm: I'll send the calendar invite for 15:30 and post the customer-facing note in #cust-comm after reviews. Action owners: sarah_csm = lead comms & call, julia_se = provisional burst, mike_support = logs + dashboard, leo_csm = commercial touch. :thumbsup:
mike_support: Thanks — marking this escalated and changing priority to P1 in Zendesk. Will update INC-81234 with any new errors.
sarah_csm: On it. Will post the customer note in 10m and join the call. After call we should capture feedback and open a follow-up item in CS playbook to prevent similar onboarding surges.
